hypothesis: Deep-subagent navigation (subagents view, open child chat, go to parent) in deep trees: the passive roster walk's legacy registry probe (legacy_registry_path) read each live child's parent transcript WHOLE to extract the header id parsed off the first line, once per parent per walk => every saved-catalog fetch (list_saved_sessions, list --all) scanned linear in the family's total transcript bytes; deep families of large parents paid pathological catalog latency.
approach: Bound the probe to the file's first line (read_first_line_bounded, 64KiB cap - the same helper/precedent the bounded session-list header read uses): same header id, one line of IO. crates/pa-daemon/src/rlm_ledger.rs fn legacy_registry_path + unit test (over-long first line reads as absent; a parent far past the cap still resolves). Diff vs 9f566686f: +51/-3, one file.
parity_notes: No wire, prompt, schema, or user-visible change on any path that does not hit the legacy registry probe. Judgment change is disclosed and tested: (1) a first line longer than 64KiB now reads as absent (base parsed it after reading the whole file - far past any real session header, same class as the 512-byte list gate); (2) a corrupt tail no longer masks a readable header (display-grade metadata either way). read_first_line_bounded is pre-existing upstream code with its own test coverage (bounded matches, unterminated, CRLF, empty, over-long).

validity.notes: SCOPE (orchestrator-reviewed): the win is pathological-size robustness ONLY - 4MiB/parent (102MiB family corpus, synthetic stress) warm catalog fetch -25% to -32% across three independent pairs (hist ABBA -31.6%, pair A -29.8%, pair B -25.2%). The realistic-size 442KiB/parent sensitivity probe shows NO gain and an adverse point estimate in both quiet pairs (pair A warm p50 9.2->11.3ms +23%, pair B 10.05->11.38ms +13.2%; cold lists parity), driven by per-trial all-sample elevations in some cand trials (probe itself reads strictly less IO; leading suspects writeback/flusher coincidence or lost whole-file pre-warm for the scan cache's tail re-reads - unresolved, disclosed). Normal-scale unpadded lists parity (+0.1-0.2ms). PTY legs: the ~0.5-1.1s open_child/go_parent legs are worker-spawn-bound and bimodal (fast ~55-78ms / slow ~515-1228ms modes); mode mix flips between arms and pairs (pair A: cand faster; pair B: base faster) - no consistent regression or win; the clean open_view chrome leg is 114.1-114.5ms parity in both pairs; RSS parity (186.4->185.9, 183.4->184.7). The historical +3.6%/+8.0% PTY transcript 'regression' did not reproduce on quiet pairs and is retired as arm-order/mode noise. Pair A base-arm 10MiB suite launch/tail legs ran in the load shadow of fresh 400MB binary builds (loadavg_before 3.18-4.72): cand ~14% faster there, labeled SUSPECT-ENVIRONMENTAL and excluded from claims (pair B, run settled and quiet with stable CPU calibration, shows cold_start launch parity). One-off stalls disclosed: pair B cand cold_start trial0 (first-paint 1001.7ms, ready 1259.7ms, remaining trials normal), pair A cand pad-4mib trial2 after_append 417.6ms single sample, pair B cand pad-4mib trial2 cold 569.6ms single trial. Same-commit discipline: both pairs are pure-base-vs-folded-lane-head on the same VM with sha-asserted binary swaps; pair B is the PR-head pair (9f566686f vs 22996c87e). Synthetic-stress disclaimer: 4MiB/parent padding is NOT Kevin's ~442k-token context and is never equated with it.
